tasks.brief: Implement src/services/echo.py: Define function echo(message: str) -> str that returns 'Echo: ' + message verbatim. No imports of web layer, no I/O, no FastAPI. Acceptance: echo('test') == 'Echo: test', echo('') == 'Echo: ', echo('hello world') == 'Echo: hello world'.

Implement src/api/chat.py: Define FastAPI APIRouter with POST /api/v1/chat endpoint. Import ChatRequest and ChatResponse from contracts (or define locally matching schema:ChatRequest/schema:ChatResponse). Import echo from src.services.echo. Endpoint validates request body against ChatRequest, calls echo(message), returns {'reply': result}. Acceptance: POST /api/v1/chat with {"message": "test"} returns 200 with {'reply': 'Echo: test'}, POST with missing message returns 422.

Implement src/main.py: Create FastAPI app, include chat router from src.api.chat. Resolve src/static/index.html relative to this module's location (not cwd) and serve it at GET / with Content-Type: text/html. Expose app as module-level symbol src.main:app. Acceptance: GET / returns HTML content with Content-Type text/html, app is importable as src.main:app.

Implement src/static/index.html: Self-contained HTML with inline CSS and JS. Render input field, on submit POST {"message": <text>} to /api/v1/chat. On response, append reply as chat bubble. Must contain literal endpoint path '/api/v1/chat'. Acceptance: HTML contains form/input, JS POSTs to /api/v1/chat, response reply is appended as bubble.
tasks.smoke_check: Verify HTML file contains '/api/v1/chat' literal string and has form/input elements with JS POST logic.
